plans.title: Schoenberg Music Building floor 1

source.publisher: UCLA Herb Alpert School of Music
source.what: "Schoenberg Hall - 1st Floor" architectural plan (scan in a PDF, room numbers, scale bar, north arrow)

plans.how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan was fitted to the ground with a similarity transform on 3 control points (stair 1500ST, under floor 2's stair 2500ST (position from the floor 2 trace); stair 1655ST, under floor 2's stair 2655ST; stair 1201ST, under floor 2's stair 2201ST).

control.what: stair 1500ST, under floor 2's stair 2500ST (position from the floor 2 trace)

notes: The plan is a scan drawn with north to the left, like the floor 2 sheet (both show the auditorium at the left and the long east wing along the top).

The outline fit (ICP) could not find the footprint on this scan and the automatic stair-label stacking found no readable labels, so the floor is pinned to floor 2 through three stairs read off both sheets by hand: 1500ST under 2500ST, 1655ST under 2655ST and 1201ST under 2201ST (floor 2 positions from its trace record).
OCR misreads on this scan are corrected with set (1503B, 1642, 1555, 1133A); 1200 is set back to a room (the tracer takes "Jan" for a janitor's closet).

The Green Room 1230 is still merged with corridor 1500CU through its door; Student Services 1672 (drawn in the courtyard) falls outside the building outline and is dropped. The plan's exterior colonnade on the north face and the Gamelan room's outside steps reach up to 7.7 m outside the OSM outline.

plans.title: Schoenberg Music Building floor 2

source.publisher: UCLA Herb Alpert School of Music
source.what: "Schoenberg Music Bldg. 2nd Floor" architectural plan, updated 2016-11-28 (CAD drawing in a PDF, every room number with its area, scale bar, north arrow)

plans.how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan has no scale or north arrow, so its building outline was fitted to the mapped outline (scale, rotation and shift, by iterative closest point).

fit.transform: similarity, plan footprint fitted to the building outline (ICP)

notes: Every room on this plan carries its area in square feet under the number ("243sf"); the tracer reads those as room numbers too and flags the rooms as merged, so each flagged room is given its real number back with a set entry taken from the flag list (kind from the UCLA suffix: ST stair, CO/CU/LO corridor). A tracer rule ignoring tokens ending in SF would make these unnecessary.
The plan is drawn with north to the left (its north arrow); the outline fit confirms it (rotation -90 degrees).
Rooms 2405, 2403 and 2404A (around corridor 2488CO) and 2843A with a stair are still merged through their door gaps.
The music library's upper rooms (1102M, 1102P, 1102X, 1188) are drawn on this sheet and kept with their numbers.

Rendered at 200 dpi (not 300): the 300 dpi raster of this sheet needs more memory than the trace machine allows alongside the other traces; the set positions were taken from a 300 dpi dry run and scaled by 2/3.
